description: Zenodo publishes release 2 of the Mexico Basin hydrogeological units dataset. The listed ZIP holds linear and polygon Shapefiles for subsurface units, surface faults and topographic sections, with Python scripts for section and azimuth work. The repository gives CC BY 4.0 and public access without a fee. These mapped units can define groundwater-model layers or geological boundaries for water-supply and subsidence simulations in the Mexico Basin. They are interpreted regional geometries, not direct measurements of transmissivity or a calibrated flow model. Users need to inspect the archive's coordinate system, scale and attribute definitions before aligning its polygons with wells or infrastructure assets; those internal files were not opened here. The accompanying scripts are project helpers inside this release, not a separate maintained simulation platform. This dataset complements data-isric-soilgrids-global-soil-maps with interpreted regional hydrogeology, not global near-surface soil estimates. No archive or executable was downloaded. A limitation is that map boundaries alone cannot establish aquifer permeability or local well yield.
